name: China economy
summary: China services growth slows to 50.8 in October; factory PMI in contraction
state: China's Caixin services PMI eased to 50.8 in October, a three-month low, as confidence weakened (Yahoo Finance; investingLive, 4 Nov). The official manufacturing PMI was 49.3 and regulators paused IPOs to steady stocks in early November. Q3 GDP grew 4.5%, near target, with no sign of financial contagion as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Slower Chinese demand weighs on commodity exporters and firms selling into China; no acute disruption is reported.
rubric_hit: Growth near target, no contagion = Normal

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — China's services growth slows to three-month low
investingLive — China services PMI slows to 50.8 in October

why: China is the world's factory and the biggest marginal buyer of commodities; a hard landing would ripple through every supply chain.
drivers: Property sector, local-government debt, exports and tariffs, deflation, stimulus.

rubric.alert: Hard landing (growth < 3%), financial contagion, or capital controls tightened sharply.
rubric.watch: Deflation, renewed property-developer defaults, or growth clearly below target.
rubric.normal: Growth near official target, stable property sales, no financial contagion.
